purpose: Consolidated Area Tasks (achievement diary) skilling-relevant rewards for every Equilibrium region mapping. Expands thin or partial diary pointers elsewhere (gloves, cloak Ourania-only, desert amulet 4 stub, sea boots, explorer ring) into full tier 1-4 skilling effect bundles. No Anachronia or Havenhythe Area Tasks set exists on the wiki.

policy.region_rule: region_hint maps diary geography to Equilibrium planner regions: Varrock/Lumbridge/Underworld -> misthalin; Falador -> asgarnia; Ardougne/Seers -> kandarin; Fremennik -> fremennik; Karamja -> karamja; Desert -> desert; Morytania -> morytania; Wilderness/Daemonheim -> forinthry; Tirannwn -> tirannwn. City of Um Underworld tasks use historical Misthalin working taxonomy.
policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise permanent skilling throughput, supply, patch, RC, Prayer, Agility, teleports, and shop QoL. Pure combat damage/PvP-only effects are omitted or one-line notes only.
policy.rate_rule: Do not invent XP/hour. Record unlock state and wiki-stated chance/percent effects only.
policy.scope_rule: Canonical RS3 Area Tasks reward set only. Daemonheim aura items were removed 13 April 2026 (Aura Overhaul); effects remain as passive achievement unlocks. Anachronia and Havenhythe have no diary reward item.
policy.id_rule: Ids use area-tasks infix so this catalog coexists with thinner regional rows without Map overwrite of partial ids.

activity_additions.name: Area Tasks (achievement diaries) skilling overview
requirements: Members for all Area Tasks sets except some free Lumbridge achievements
Prior reward tier claimed before the next (e.g. armour 2 before armour 3)
Skill, quest, and activity gates per easy/medium/hard/elite subcategory
unlocks: One worn-equipment reward family per classic Area Tasks region (cloak, amulet, ring, shield, boots, gloves, legs, headband, quiver, armour, sword, grimoire)
Task Master emote after completing all Area Tasks achievements
Daemonheim Area Tasks benefits are passive (aura items removed)
activity_additions.notes: Planner multi-host frame for all classic diary regions (user KEEP). Each diary is completed in its own geography; required_regions lists every diary-owning region so hosts + comboLabel stay in sync. Prefer per-region equipment rows below for stacking.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Multi-ok on every classic Area Tasks region with matching all_required list. Achievement/quest gates follow Equilibrium auto-quest overlays. Per-region reward items still live on dedicated area-tasks equipment rows.

activity_additions.name: Daemonheim Area Tasks passive rewards
requirements: Easy through elite Daemonheim achievements claimed in order
Aura items themselves removed in Aura Overhaul (13 April 2026); unlocks remain
unlocks: Easy: secondary ring of kinship role at 25% effectiveness; daily boss choice; one consequence-free death per day in a dungeon (not hard mode)

Medium: secondary role 50%; potion bind slot; Smuggler 40 law + cosmic runes each dungeon; Daemonheim Peninsula Island extension (yew trees + deposit box); in-dungeon ammo return and auto-bury when the old aura-worn effects apply as passives
Hard: secondary role 75%; +2 bind pool slots; 5% recharge cost reduction; +10% Sinkholes rewards; Dwarven Mine resource dungeon extension (phasmatite)

Elite: secondary role 100%; hard mode party-leader start; 10% Smuggler discount; Brimhaven resource dungeon extension (mithril dragons); Gatestone 2 access; bone-to-prayer restore operate effect (1 hour, 3 hour cooldown) as documented historically
activity_additions.notes: Not a wearable diary item post-Aura Overhaul. Track as Forinthry Dungeoneering permanent unlocks. Resource-dungeon extensions are the main skilling geography side-effect outside floors.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Forinthry (Daemonheim). Do not list a Daemonheim aura equipment piece for live Equilibrium planning.
